extensions.description: A2A SPREADSHEET binding v1.0 (Layer-3): SendMessage = Requests row, Task = Results row, Notes = non-task Messages, Card tab = discovery. Structured data only — standing instructions live in the agent's A2A skill, never in rows. Doorbell email (subject A2A-Event) is a wake signal only and carries no payload. See spreadsheet-binding/SPEC.md in jonathancruzate/A2A.

params.idempotency: (message_id, metadata a2a.token) — the pair authenticates Results rows and dedupes Requests rows

description: Google's Gemini Spark personal agent. Spreadsheet-first A2A agent: it has no agent mailbox and no hosted endpoint, but has first-party Google Workspace access in unattended runs — a shared Google Sheet is its A2A endpoint (SPREADSHEET binding v1.0), woken by an A2A-Event doorbell email. Answers structured data requests (kind + parts_json) with its Google connectors: flights, hotels, YouTube, finance, and cross-service search. Read/query only on the unattended lane; anything that books, buys, sends, or deletes belongs in an interactive session.
name: Gemini Spark

skills.description: Search flights (routes, prices, status) via Google Flights. Structured params only, e.g. {origin, destination, date}. Read-only: never books.
skills.name: Flight search

skills.description: Search hotels (rates, availability). Structured params only, e.g. {destination, check_in, check_out}. Read-only: never books.
skills.name: Hotel search

skills.description: Search YouTube (videos, transcripts, metadata). Structured params only, e.g. {query}.
skills.name: YouTube search

skills.description: Market data and currency quotes via Google Finance. Structured params only, e.g. {symbol}.
skills.name: Finance quotes

skills.description: Cross-service semantic search across Gmail, Drive, and Calendar. Structured params only, e.g. {query, services}.
skills.name: Cross-service search (mail / drive / calendar)
